alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: {{class_s}} event occurred for object {{custom_details_objectName_s}} with type {{custom_details_objectType_s}}

properties.description: 'Creates an incident for Classification events (ClassficationResultsAvailable) for non DSPM license users.'
properties.query:
Rubrik_Violation_Data_CL
| where class_s == "Classification" and custom_details_eventName_s in ("ClassficationResultsAvailable", "ClassificationResultsAvailable")
| extend NewSeverity = case(severity_s=="info", "Low",
                            severity_s=="warning", "Medium",
                            severity_s=="critical", "High",
                            "Informational"),
         ObjectId = iff(isnotempty(custom_details_objectId_s), custom_details_objectId_s, tostring(custom_details_objectId_g)),
         SnapshotId = custom_details_snapshotId_s
properties.name: Create Incident for Classification events for non DSPM license users
